news.titleEn: S&P 500 and Dow close in correction; Nasdaq erases 2026 gain as AI rout picks up steam
news.conclusionEn: US stocks capped their worst week since 2020 on Friday: the S&P 500 fell about 3.7% and the Nasdaq 5.3%, pushing the S&P and Dow into correction and wiping out the Nasdaq's 2026 gain.
news.conclusionZh: 美股创2020年来最差一周，标普道指进入回调，纳指年内转跌
news.whyEn: A 10%+ drop from peak with the VIX above 37 signals a broad risk-off shift that hits retirement accounts, tech valuations and global markets, and raises the stakes for next week's PCE inflation data and Black Friday.
news.whyZh: 恐慌指数升破37，全球风险资产承压，下周通胀数据和黑五更受关注
news.detailEn: The S&P 500 closed near 6,910 and the Dow near 48,147, both more than 10% below their peaks, while the Nasdaq Composite ended at 22,617.73 and is now down for the year. The selloff was driven by doubts over the financing and returns of the AI buildout, an SEC probe into Nvidia, a slide in Anthropic shares after its record IPO and a report that Google trimmed Broadcom AI chip orders. Higher-for-longer rate fears added pressure, with the Fed widely expected to hike in December. Investors now watch PCE inflation and holiday retail spending to judge whether the rout deepens.
news.detailZh: 标普500收于约6910点、道指约48147点，均较高点下跌超10%；纳指收于22617.73点，年内转为下跌。抛售源于市场对AI基建融资与回报的怀疑、美国证监会调查英伟达、Anthropic创纪录上市后股价走弱，以及谷歌削减博通AI芯片订单的报道。市场普遍预计美联储12月加息，进一步加重压力。投资者接下来将通过PCE通胀数据和假日零售来判断跌势是否会延续。

news.titleEn: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia shares plunged about 14% on Friday after Reuters reported the SEC is examining the company's accounting, extending a seven-week losing streak that is its longest since 2008.
news.conclusionZh: 传SEC调查会计问题，英伟达单日暴跌14%，七周连跌
news.whyEn: Nvidia is the bellwether of the AI trade and one of the largest index weights, so an accounting probe on top of leadership turmoil drags on chipmakers, index funds and AI spending sentiment worldwide.
news.whyZh: 英伟达是AI风向标和指数重仓股，调查拖累芯片股和全球AI情绪
news.detailEn: According to Reuters, SEC enforcement staff are looking into potential accounting issues at Nvidia, though the timing and scope are unclear and the SEC declined to comment. Coverage points to questions over how Nvidia reports geographic revenue, including sales booked through its Singapore unit. The stock is down roughly 46% over seven weeks, erasing trillions in market value even though its latest quarterly results beat estimates. Any formal enforcement action or restatement would be a major blow to the AI hardware supply chain.
news.detailZh: 据路透社报道，美国证监会执法部门正在调查英伟达潜在的会计问题，但时间和范围尚不明确，证监会拒绝置评。报道指向英伟达对地区营收的披露方式，包括通过新加坡子公司入账的销售额。尽管最新季度业绩超预期，其股价七周累计跌约46%，蒸发数万亿美元市值。若出现正式执法或财报重述，将重创整个AI硬件供应链。

news.titleEn: Anthropic Sinks 9% on Day Two as AI Selloff Deepens: Strategist Warns Against "Chasing the IPO"
news.conclusionEn: Anthropic shares fell about 9% on their second trading day, briefly dipping to within cents of the $83 IPO price before closing around $88.
news.conclusionZh: Anthropic上市次日跌约9%，一度逼近83美元发行价
news.whyEn: As the largest IPO on record, Anthropic is a test of public-market appetite for AI labs; a weak debut could chill upcoming tech listings and private AI valuations.
news.whyZh: 史上最大IPO遇冷，可能拖累后续科技上市和AI公司估值
news.detailEn: After jumping about 17% on its debut, Anthropic gave back most of those gains on Friday as the broader AI selloff intensified. Underwriters fully exercised their over-allotment option, lifting gross proceeds to about $93.5 billion. Strategists warned retail investors against chasing hot IPOs amid concerns over valuations, profitability and heavy AI capital spending. Whether the stock holds above its offer price will shape sentiment for other AI companies weighing listings.
news.detailZh: Anthropic首日上涨约17%，但周五在AI板块抛售加剧下回吐大部分涨幅。承销商全额行使超额配售权，募资总额升至约935亿美元。分析师提醒散户不要追高热门新股，市场担忧估值、盈利能力和巨额AI资本开支。股价能否守住发行价，将影响其他计划上市的AI公司的市场情绪。

news.titleEn: Trump vows to stop U.S. companies from building data centers abroad, threatens 'tremendous tax'
news.conclusionEn: President Trump said the US will not allow American companies to build data centers in other countries and threatened a "tremendous tax" on those that do.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普称将对在海外建数据中心的美企征「巨额税」
news.whyEn: Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet, Meta and Oracle have large overseas data center plans, so any such policy would reshape global AI infrastructure investment and hit countries courting those projects.
news.whyZh: 直接影响美国云巨头海外布局，以及争取数据中心投资的国家
news.detailEn: Speaking at a White House press conference on Friday, Trump said companies could still build abroad but would face a heavy tax, adding that he had not yet discussed the idea with his own team. No formal policy or legal mechanism has been announced. The remarks come as hyperscalers are committing hundreds of billions of dollars to data centers worldwide, including in Europe, Asia and the Middle East. Details, if any follow, will determine how seriously companies need to revise their global plans.
news.detailZh: 特朗普周五在白宫记者会上表示，企业仍可在海外建设，但将面临重税，并称自己「还没和团队说过」这一想法。目前尚无正式政策或法律机制。当前云计算巨头正在全球投入数千亿美元建设数据中心，覆盖欧洲、亚洲和中东。后续是否出台具体细则，将决定企业是否需要大幅调整全球布局。

news.titleEn: CrowdStrike in Talks to Acquire Zscaler in Potential Cybersecurity Mega-Deal
news.conclusionEn: CrowdStrike is in talks to acquire Zscaler in what would be one of the largest cybersecurity deals ever, creating a company worth about $265 billion combined.
news.conclusionZh: CrowdStrike洽购Zscaler，或成网络安全史上最大交易之一
news.whyEn: The deal would accelerate consolidation in cybersecurity, as large customers increasingly prefer one platform over many point products; it pressures rivals like Palo Alto Networks.
news.whyZh: 加速网安行业整合，企业客户更偏好一站式平台，对手承压
news.detailEn: People familiar with the matter told Bloomberg the companies are discussing a combination that could come together soon, but there is no certainty of a deal and neither company has confirmed it. Zscaler, valued at about $32 billion, specializes in cloud-based network security, complementing CrowdStrike's Falcon endpoint platform. Zscaler shares jumped about 18% in extended trading, while CrowdStrike fell more than 8%. Any agreement would likely face antitrust review given both companies' scale.
news.detailZh: 知情人士向彭博透露，双方正在商讨合并，可能很快达成，但交易并不确定，两家公司均未证实。Zscaler市值约320亿美元，专注云端网络安全，与CrowdStrike的Falcon终端安全平台互补。消息传出后Zscaler盘后大涨约18%，CrowdStrike则跌超8%。考虑到双方规模，若达成协议可能面临反垄断审查。

news.titleEn: Bahrain says Iranian attack causes fire at industrial facility
news.conclusionEn: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they struck US air defence radars at bases in Bahrain, while Bahrain reported a fire at an industrial facility with no injuries.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗革命卫队称袭击巴林美军雷达，巴林一工业设施起火
news.whyEn: Repeated Iranian strikes on a Gulf state hosting the US Fifth Fleet raise the risk of wider escalation and keep a risk premium on oil and shipping through Hormuz.
news.whyZh: 美第五舰队驻地反复遭袭，冲突升级风险推高油价和航运风险
news.detailEn: The IRGC described a combined missile and drone operation and linked it to a US attack on a radar installation on Iran's Hengam Island; its claims about destroyed radars have not been independently confirmed. Iranian media called it the fourth attack on Bahrain in nine days after a lull since September. Separately, Washington has imposed new sanctions on Iranians it says acted as oil trustees, and Trump this week warned Iran over a reported dirty-bomb plot. Markets are watching whether the US responds with new strikes.
news.detailZh: 革命卫队称这是一次导弹加无人机联合行动，作为对美方袭击伊朗亨加姆岛雷达设施的回应，其摧毁雷达的说法尚未得到独立证实。伊朗媒体称这是9天内第4次袭击巴林，此前自9月起局势相对平静。另外，美国对4名被指充当石油「代理人」的伊朗人实施制裁，特朗普本周也就所谓「脏弹」阴谋向伊朗发出警告。市场关注美国是否会再度动武。

news.titleEn: Oil Futures Fall for Third Straight Week on Supply Outlook
news.conclusionEn: Brent settled around $92.57 on Friday, up slightly on the day on Middle East tensions but down about 3.4% for a third straight weekly decline.
news.conclusionZh: 布油周五收于约92.57美元，连续第三周下跌
news.whyEn: Oil sits at the center of the inflation outlook: ample supply is offsetting war risk for now, which matters for fuel costs, central bank decisions and energy stocks.
news.whyZh: 油价牵动通胀和央行决策，目前供应充足抵消了战争风险
news.detailEn: Traders weighed the risk of renewed US strikes on Iran against expectations of a global supply surplus and steady flows through the Strait of Hormuz. WTI settled near $84 a barrel. Attention now turns to the OPEC+ meeting on November 29, where producers will discuss 2027 output quotas. A major escalation in the Gulf could quickly reverse the downtrend.
news.detailZh: 交易员在美国可能再次打击伊朗的风险与全球供应过剩预期、霍尔木兹海峡航运稳定之间权衡。WTI收于每桶约84美元。市场焦点转向11月29日的欧佩克+会议，届时将讨论2027年产量配额。若海湾局势大幅升级，油价下行趋势可能迅速逆转。

news.titleEn: UK says new deal will 'rebuild bridges' with EU: What's in it?
news.conclusionEn: The EU and UK concluded deals on food checks, linking their carbon markets and youth mobility at a Brussels summit, the biggest reset since Brexit.
news.conclusionZh: 英欧峰会达成食品检疫、碳市场挂钩等协议，脱欧后最大重启
news.whyEn: Easing food checks and exempting each other's goods such as steel from carbon border levies cuts costs for exporters, retailers and manufacturers on both sides.
news.whyZh: 减少食品检查、互免碳边境税，降低双方出口商和制造业成本
news.detailEn: At the November 20 summit, leaders welcomed the conclusion of a sanitary and phytosanitary agreement and a deal to link their emissions trading systems, aimed to apply from 2028. A youth mobility programme and a competition cooperation agreement were also agreed. Talks on university tuition fees were deferred for six months, and UK participation in the EU electricity market remains tied to an unresolved financial contribution. Months of detailed negotiation and ratification still lie ahead.
news.detailZh: 在11月20日的峰会上，双方宣布完成动植物卫生检疫协议谈判，并就碳排放交易体系挂钩达成一致，目标2028年起实施。双方还同意了青年流动计划和竞争合作协议。大学学费问题推迟6个月再议，英国加入欧盟电力市场仍与尚未谈妥的资金贡献挂钩。后续仍需数月的细节谈判和批准程序。

news.titleEn: Russian strikes on Kyiv kill six and damage two bridges
news.conclusionEn: A large overnight Russian missile and drone attack killed at least six people in Kyiv, damaged bridges over the Dnipro and cut power in several districts.
news.conclusionZh: 俄军大规模空袭基辅至少6死，第聂伯河桥梁受损
news.whyEn: Strikes on bridges and energy infrastructure ahead of winter deepen Ukraine's humanitarian and economic strain and dim prospects for a ceasefire.
news.whyZh: 入冬前打击桥梁和能源设施，加重乌克兰困境，停火更难
news.detailEn: The barrage reportedly involved more than 400 drones and over 110 missiles, and was linked to Moscow's threatened response to Ukrainian attacks on the Crimean bridge. Kyiv's mayor said the Podil-Voskresensky and Darnytskyi bridges were damaged. Russia said it targeted military-industrial and energy sites. Air raid sirens also sounded in Polish cities, underscoring the risk of spillover to NATO territory.
news.detailZh: 据报道，此次袭击动用400多架无人机和110多枚导弹，被认为是莫斯科对乌克兰袭击克里米亚大桥的报复。基辅市长称波季尔-沃斯克列先斯基桥和达尔尼茨基桥受损。俄方称打击目标为军工和能源设施。波兰多个城市也拉响防空警报，凸显冲突外溢至北约领土的风险。

businessTips.explanationEn: Platformization is when customers replace many single-purpose vendors with one broader platform that covers multiple needs. Buyers like it because it reduces integration work, contracts and training; vendors like it because it raises switching costs and revenue per customer. It is a major driver of M&A in software, as companies buy rivals to fill gaps in their platform.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「平台化」指客户用一个覆盖多种需求的综合平台，取代多个单一功能的供应商。买方喜欢它，因为可以减少系统对接、合同和培训成本；卖方喜欢它，因为能提高客户转换成本和单客收入。这也是软件行业并购的主要推动力：公司通过收购对手来补齐平台短板。
businessTips.exampleEn: CrowdStrike's reported talks to buy Zscaler would add network security to its endpoint platform, letting it sell one bundle instead of competing product by product. For a small business, the same logic applies when choosing one tool that handles bookings, payments and messaging rather than three separate apps.
businessTips.exampleZh: CrowdStrike洽购Zscaler，就是想把网络安全加进终端安全平台，用一揽子方案代替逐个产品竞争。对小企业来说同样适用：选一个能同时处理预订、收款和客户消息的工具，而不是用三个独立App。

businessTips.explanationEn: Print-on-demand lets you sell custom products such as T-shirts, mugs or posters without holding inventory: a partner prints and ships each item only after a customer orders. It removes upfront stock risk, so you can test many designs cheaply. The trade-off is lower margins per item and less control over quality and delivery times.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「按需印刷」让你无需囤货就能销售T恤、马克杯、海报等定制商品：顾客下单后，合作方才印刷并发货。它消除了前期库存风险，可以低成本测试大量设计。代价是单件利润较低，对质量和发货时效的控制也较弱。
businessTips.exampleEn: A local food blogger could launch a small merch line of illustrated tote bags through a POD service linked to an online store, ordering one sample first to check print quality. Only the designs that sell well would later justify bulk printing for higher margins.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位美食博主可以通过对接网店的按需印刷服务，推出一组手绘帆布袋周边，先下一单样品检查印刷质量。只有卖得好的款式，之后才值得批量印刷以提高利润。

businessTips.explanationEn: A market correction is a decline of at least 10% (but less than 20%) from a recent peak in a stock index; a drop of 20% or more is called a bear market. Corrections are fairly common, happening on average roughly once every year or two, and many recover within months. Knowing the definition helps investors keep sharp drops in perspective instead of reacting emotionally.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「市场回调」指股指从近期高点下跌至少10%但不到20%；跌幅达20%及以上则称为熊市。回调相当常见，平均大约每一两年发生一次，很多在数月内收复失地。了解这个定义，有助于投资者理性看待大跌，而不是情绪化操作。
businessTips.exampleEn: This week the S&P 500 and Dow both closed more than 10% below their peaks, officially entering correction territory. A long-term investor with a regular monthly contribution plan might simply keep investing, buying more units at lower prices, rather than selling in a panic.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周标普500和道指收盘均较高点下跌超10%，正式进入回调区间。坚持每月定投的长期投资者可以照常投入，以更低价格买入更多份额，而不是恐慌性抛售。
